messages:
sarah: Quick check — can we run a short RFC review session tomorrow that's optimized for async reviewers? thinking of a "lightning" format: 10m author + 5m reviewer notes, strict prep. who can take facilitator?

devin: I can facilitate if no one else has a conflict. prefer 9:30am PT or 4:30pm CET slots.

alex: 9:30am PT works for me. i'll be the first author (runtime change).

tara: 4:30pm CET is better for me (timezone). happy to swap order if that helps.

sarah: thanks — goal is to limit live discussion to clarifying q's only. authors should upload a 1-page pre-read and an example request/response. i added a tiny checklist below.

jen: checklist ack. can authors paste a short sample input into the thread so reviewers can sanity-check quickly?

mike: tagging a doc reminder — docs not uploaded yet for alex's RFC. alex can you paste the sample here?

alex: pasted sample below — truncated for thread.
```
input: {
  "prompt": "Describe cache invalidation tradeoffs in continuous batching",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
response: {
  "summary": "KV cache reduces latency at cost of stale prefixes..."
}
```

sarah: perfect. agenda proposal: 1) quick rollcall (2m) 2) author 1 (10m) 3) author 2 (10m) 4) backlog / async followups (8m). devin if you facilitate can we enforce timer and one-sentence clarifications?

devin: yes — i'll run a visible timer and call for followups to be filed as comments on the PR.

tara: small request — can we put authors who need timezone accommodation earlier? i can swap with alex if that helps.

alex: i'm happy to swap; tara take the first slot and i'll be second.

sarah: swapped. final order: tara, alex, jen (if she has something), then backlog. jen — do you want to present anything?

jen: I don't have a full RFC but a 5min infra note — happy to be the quick third item.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: RFC lightning review — Tomorrow 09:30 PT / 16:30 CET. Invite: #eng. Link: https://calendar.example/meeting/abc123

mike: tiny ask — can we add a "must-read" tag to the PRs so reviewers know priority?

sarah: done. please add the tag + the 1-paragraph summary to the PR description.

devin: final: i'll post the timer and post-meeting followups doc. Everyone please upload pre-read by EOD today. :thumbsup:

sarah: thanks team — see you tomorrow. if anything changes ping in thread. :wave:
